review:
Eye of Medusa is a 5-reel, 5-row Hacksaw Gaming slot with ways wins and Super Cascades, which remove every winning symbol and drop new ones in. The Medusa symbol changes how each cascade plays out: on a low-paying win it stays put while the rest refill, and on a high-paying win those symbols are petrified and sink to the bottom with Medusa.

When the cascade ends, petrified symbols reveal multipliers up to 500x and Medusa boosts the total by up to 20x. Three or four FS start Snakes & Stones with 10 or 12 free spins and a better chance of strong Medusa symbols. Five FS start Gorgon's Gold, where Medusa has a minimum multiplier that can grow. Hacksaw lists a 10,000x max win.
